parameters.componentSubtitle: Displays a Drupal View as an HTML list using Bootstrap utility classes.

description.component: A component to render view rows in a list format (`<ul>` or `<ol>`) with customizable utility classes.

type.name: List Type
type.description: The type of list: unordered (ul) or ordered (ol).

list_utility_classes.name: List Utility Classes
list_utility_classes.description: Extra Bootstrap or custom utility classes to apply to the list container.

list_item_utility_classes.name: List Item Utility Classes
list_item_utility_classes.description: Utility classes for each list item (`<li>`).

attributes.name: Attributes
attributes.description: HTML attributes applied to the outer list element.

rows.name: Rows
rows.description: An array of view row renderable objects.
